daily.title: Everything starts here
daily.body: This is the form you will open each evening. Energy, sleep, technical study and deep work are the four that matter; the rest is optional. Every other page reads back from here, so a day you skip is a gap everywhere. Past days can be filled in whenever you like.

home.title: You are on the dashboard
home.body: This is where the app reads you back: today's score comes from the day's log, and clicking it shows each part that made it — not a number from nowhere. Beside it sit yesterday, your streaks, and trends once there are a few days to draw. Next, where those numbers come from.

habits.title: Habits that tick themselves
habits.body: This button makes one. The part worth using is binding a habit to a metric: "sleep at least 7 hours" ticks itself from the day's log, so you never enter it twice. A streak survives one missed day.

goals.title: Goals that track themselves
goals.body: This button makes a goal. A numeric one — "300 minutes of study a week" — fills its own progress bar from your data, with nothing to update by hand. In the list, press and drag the handle on the left to reorder them.

timer.title: Time it, and it files itself
timer.body: Pick what you are doing and press this. Space bar starts and stops it too. The thing to remember: when you stop, the minutes go where they belong — study becomes a session, exercise becomes a workout under Health, reading is added to the day's log. Nothing to enter a second time.

learning.title: Notes that link to each other
learning.body: This button writes a note. Type [[the title of another note]] in the body and it becomes a link both ways — the other note will list this one under "Linked from". The Sessions tab beside it is where your study hours and topics live.

finance.title: Money starts with an account
finance.body: Make an account first — BIDV, Momo, cash — and transactions have somewhere to go. For a debt, enter the opening balance as a negative number. Moving money between two accounts is a Transfer: one row covers both ends, so income is never inflated.

settings.title: The data is yours
settings.body: This is where you download everything as JSON, whenever you want, without asking anyone. Further up the page: English or Vietnamese, your time zone, when a day rolls over, and the weights behind the score. That is the tour — open the day log and fill in today.
